SELinux fcontext                                   type               Context

/                                                  directory          system_u:object_r:root_t:s0 
/.*                                                all files          system_u:object_r:default_t:s0 
/[^/]+                                             regular file       system_u:object_r:etc_runtime_t:s0 
/\.autofsck                                        regular file       system_u:object_r:etc_runtime_t:s0 
/\.autorelabel                                     regular file       system_u:object_r:etc_runtime_t:s0 
/\.ismount-test-file                               regular file       system_u:object_r:sosreport_tmp_t:s0 
/\.journal                                         all files          <<None>>
/boot/\.journal                                    all files          <<None>>
/dev/(misc/)?agpgart                               character device   system_u:object_r:agp_device_t:s0 
/dev/[shmxv]d[^/]*                                 block device       system_u:object_r:fixed_disk_device_t:s0 
/dev/gpmctl                                        socket             system_u:object_r:gpmctl_t:s0 
/dev/gpmdata                                       named pipe         system_u:object_r:gpmctl_t:s0 
/dev/log                                           symbolic link      system_u:object_r:devlog_t:s0 
/srv/halite-cap(/.*)?                              all files          system_u:object_r:httpd_sys_content_t:s0 
/srv/halite-cap-dir                                directory          system_u:object_r:public_content_t:s0 
/srv/halite-cap-user                               all files          user_u:object_r:httpd_sys_content_t:s0 
/var/www(/.*)?                                     all files          system_u:object_r:httpd_sys_content_t:s0 
/vicepa                                            all files          system_u:object_r:public_content_t:s0 
/vicepb                                            all files          system_u:object_r:afs_files_t:s0 
/vmlinuz.*                                         symbolic link      system_u:object_r:boot_t:s0 
/xen(/.*)?                                         all files          system_u:object_r:xen_image_t:s0 

SELinux Distribution fcontext Equivalence 

/run = /var/run
/run/lock = /var/lock
/run/systemd/system = /usr/lib/systemd/system
/run/systemd/generator = /usr/lib/systemd/system
/run/systemd/generator.early = /usr/lib/systemd/system
/run/systemd/generator.late = /usr/lib/systemd/system
/lib = /usr/lib
/lib64 = /usr/lib
/usr/lib64 = /usr/lib
/usr/local/lib64 = /usr/lib
/usr/local/lib32 = /usr/lib
/etc/systemd/system = /usr/lib/systemd/system
/var/lib/xguest/home = /home
/var/named/chroot/usr/lib64 = /usr/lib
/var/named/chroot/lib64 = /usr/lib
/var/named/chroot/var = /var
/home-inst = /home
/home/home-inst = /home
/var/roothome = /root
/sbin = /usr/sbin
/sysroot/tmp = /tmp
/var/usrlocal = /usr/local
/var/mnt = /mnt
